title: A held tool call: park, answer, resume
subtitle: A turn waiting on a person holds no worker

messages.label: mode normal: no recorded decision -> Deferred
turn parks on a synthetic approve_tool_call; lease released
decision stored under tool_approval/ (bound to the exact arguments)
new lease folds the log: the open turn resumes
the gated call runs once, with its recorded answer

messages.text: What was approved is read back from the emitted tool.call_requested event — never from the request body
